mxCell.value: Storage model: In-memory (sync.RWMutex maps). Persistence via Kafka events to Data Lakehouse. No dedicated PostgreSQL tables — state is computed from real-time positions.

LiquidityPosition (in-memory) ---------------------- position_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) date (timestamp) currency (varchar) total_assets / total_liabilities (int64, kobo) net_position / cash_reserves (int64) cbn_balance (int64) nostro_balances / vostro_balances (map[string]int64) LCR / NSFR / CRR (float64, ratios) status (varchar: normal/warning/critical) updated_at

CashFlow (in-memory) ---------------------- flow_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) date (timestamp) flow_type (varchar: inflow/outflow) category (varchar: deposits/withdrawals/loans/investments) amount (int64) currency (varchar) description / counter_party (varchar) status (varchar: projected/confirmed/settled) created_at

FXPosition (in-memory) ---------------------- position_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) currency (varchar) long_position / short_position (int64) net_position (int64) avg_rate / current_rate (float64) unrealized_pnl (int64) limit / utilization (float64) status (varchar: within_limit/near_limit/breached) updated_at

FXDeal (in-memory) ---------------------- deal_id / deal_number (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) deal_type (varchar: spot/forward/swap) buy_currency / sell_currency (varchar) buy_amount / sell_amount (int64) rate (float64) value_date / maturity_date (timestamp) counter_party / counter_party_id (varchar) purpose (varchar) status (varchar: pending/approved/executed/settled/cancelled) created_at / updated_at

Investment (in-memory) ---------------------- investment_id (varchar) tenant_id (varchar) investment_type (varchar: treasury_bill/bond/fixed_deposit) issuer / issuer_id (varchar) face_value / purchase_price / current_value (int64) currency (varchar) coupon_rate / yield_rate (float64) purchase_date / maturity_date (timestamp) status (varchar: active/matured/sold) created_at
